title: P1: Search controls hide and services-catalog toolbar appears when switching to Services Catalog
verifies: Switching to Services Catalog tab hides the search controls from DOM and shows the services-catalog date-time picker toolbar

title: P1: Search controls hide and service-graph toolbar appears when switching to Service Graph (enterprise)
verifies: Switching to Service Graph tab hides the search controls from DOM and shows the service-graph-specific toolbar (date-time, refresh, tree/graph toggle)

title: P1: Switching back from Services Catalog to Traces restores search controls
verifies: Returning from Services Catalog tab to Traces tab restores all search controls and updates the active tab state

title: P2: Spans to Traces toggle updates URL and active state
verifies: Toggling between Spans and Traces tabs correctly syncs the active button state and the ?tab= URL query parameter
